dedupe_keys.name: new zealand regional hourly energy demand projections to 2050

description: The New Zealand energy-demand team publishes projections to 2050 for heat, transport and power. The current Zenodo release includes sector workbooks, a harmonized summary, supporting values, hourly profile variants and a small code example. Its description states sixteen-region and 8,760-hour resolution with annual scenarios every five years, disaggregated by fuel and technology. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. These profiles can supply demand and electrification pathways for national and regional power-system simulations using model-pypsa after adapting the network. A caveat is that projections depend on chosen policy and technology scenarios, not observed future consumption. Annual energy and hourly profiles must retain consistent scenario and region keys before aggregation. The own repository metadata and manifest were read without opening workbook values. The minimal code example is covered by this same deposit; no separate runnable model is claimed.
